name: Czech Crack
beta: Follow the obvious crack through a bulge about 20 feet up, keep going to the rappel anchors above Pony Express, then trend up and right on cracks and buckets to the top.
overview: An obvious crack climbs through a bulge low down and continues to the anchors above Pony Express; cracks and buckets then lead up and right to the top.

current.area_walk_in: The way in passes through a notch in the rock before reaching the wall.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: about 15 ft right of Pony Express

name: Dappled Mare
beta: Follow twin cracks and a corner up to a bolted belay stance. From there, traverse down-left along the crack, then ascend leftward to finish.
overview: Paired cracks and a corner reach a small ledge holding a bolt; then angle downward along the crack toward the left, before veering back up and away to the left to top out.

current.area_walk_in: A well-worn trail leaves Lost Horse Road and follows the base of the wall; allow roughly 5 to 15 minutes.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Datura
beta: Starting on the ledge above the neighboring route, clip a bolt and move into a crack that curves rightward.
overview: Begins from the ledge above Klingon Pizza, passes a bolt, and enters a crack that bends rightward.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: starting on the ledge above Klingon Pizza

name: Dead Bees
beta: Begin just right of its neighbor, climbing huecos first, then move onto smoother rock above where three bolts protect.
overview: Climbs large pockets, then a smoother face above with three bolts.

current.area_walk_in: A path heading westward dwindles away at the foot of this big rock mass, whose northeast side can be spotted from far off. Routes here begin from a ledge high above the ground; easy scrambling up cracks below gets you onto it.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: begins next to Nectar

name: Death to the Right
beta: Begin on the neighboring route, then after clipping its first bolt, veer rightward over a roof; a couple of small cams are worth bringing.
overview: Follows Step to the Left up to the first bolt, then angles rightward across a roof. It feels committing, and a pair of small cams helps.

current.area_walk_in: The path starts at the left side of the Bubble beside a lone tree and some shrubs, heads west above an outcrop of loose rock, then crosses a saddle on a slim footpath with small ups and downs. Take the left fork, which drops a little and then climbs again to the foot of the formation, where a tall bolted line stands straight ahead.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.anchor: shared with Step to the Left
current.location: shares the opening moves of Step to the Left, then leaves it once past bolt one

name: Deliverance
beta: Sustained slightly overhanging climbing on pockets and pinches, clipping eight bolts up to the anchor.
overview: A bolted overhang and pockets line. Clip 8 bolts on the way up.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Desert Sky (aka Environment-Oil President)
beta: Begin around the corner to the right, use buckets to cross the neighboring crack, then proceed vertically past three bolts.
overview: Buckets lead up and across the line of its neighbour, then directly up with three bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: 10 ft right of the preceding two routes, around the corner

name: Desperado
beta: Clip the lone bolt low down, then follow the crack closest to the dark streaks on their left.
overview: On the central stretch of the cliff, where dark streaks stand out; this is the nearest crack on their left side, with a bolt right off the ground.

current.area_walk_in: A brown wall facing north, streaked dark, with a big corner at its right end. Reach it by about a quarter hour of walking up talus.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Diagonal Crack
beta: A tree anchor at the top allows toproping, but expect a long swing if you fall before reaching the crack.
overview: A traditional crack line.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Dial Africa
beta: Begin on a ramp tending left, work leftward, then ascend a crack with three bolts for protection.
overview: Leaves a ramp that leans left, traverses leftward, then goes upward on a crack with three bolts.

current.area_walk_in: Two ways in. Starting at the rear loop of Hidden Valley Campground, head roughly north in the direction of Echo Cove; the formation sits about halfway along. Or leave the car at Echo Cove, follow the old road southwest, then take the climber trail that branches right to the rock.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: from a ramp leaning left, 30 ft right of The Watusi

name: Diamondback
beta: A Sidewinder variation: take the wall higher up and to the right of its arched crack, and merge back into it at the final bolt.
overview: An alternative line on Sidewinder: it follows the wall higher and rightward than the curved crack, then merges back at that route's last bolt.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Dick Van Dyke (aka Elvis is Everywhere)
beta: Follow the obvious dike that slants rightward, clipping four bolts along the way.
overview: An obvious dike slanting right. The first ascent went ground-up without bolts; a later party drilled them unaware it had been climbed.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: immediately after the previous route

name: Dike Flight
beta: Follow the dike as it slants leftward, clipping two bolts.
overview: A west-facing line on a big boulder beyond the end of the massif, following a dike.

current.area_walk_in: Heading downhill northwest, passing either flank of Split Rock for roughly 50 yards, brings you to the lowest left toe of the massif. For the boulder routes, swing wide beyond Overbolted Rock keeping to its rightward flank, double back left, and scramble round the dome's northwest tip.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: west side of a big boulder set just beyond the dome's end

name: Dino Damage
beta:
Leave the ledge to the right of the neighboring route and head up and a bit leftward, clipping four bolts before reaching a stance where you may belay.

Clip a single additional bolt higher up; the crux is height-dependent.
overview: Four bolts, drifting a little leftward, lead to a ledge where you can belay, then one more bolt above.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: from the ledge on the right-hand side of Leader's Fright

name: Direct East Face
beta: Skip the hard dihedral start by going up and left to the little buttress forming the foot of the Southeast Face route, then cross rightward over shallow ledges to the dihedral.
overview: The most conspicuous open-book, dihedral-style feature on the peak, sitting in the middle of the east face. It is a distinct line from the neighbouring routes on the same face.

name: Dirty Dancing
beta: Begin at the foot of Damper and angle up leftward to a flake; the crux step off it gets protection from a drilled angle.
overview: A flake-based line that starts at the foot of Damper and heads left, with the crux coming as you leave the flake.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: starting at Damper's foot and trending up and left

name: Dirty Tricks
beta: Usually toproped; leading it is possible but the top offers little protection.
overview: Only the crux has been top-roped; a lead looks possible but gear near the top is lacking, and no full lead is recorded.

current.area_walk_in: Take the main trail toward the Comic Book formation, then bear right onto the marked path that leads to the base. Allow roughly 15 to 20 minutes on foot from the car.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Don't
beta: Begin in the wide crack of a right-facing corner, move rightward to clip a bolt, then ascend a seam clipping four more.
overview: A grainy south-facing slab on Zippy Rock, with poor rock and suspect bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Drawstring
beta: Take the curving chimney beside its neighbor up to a ledge belay, then follow the crack until it ends and shift leftward to finish by an aging bolt.
overview: Curving chimney to a ledge about 50 ft up, then follow the crack until it ends and angle left to the summit.

name: Dry Lake
beta: Begin well over from Panther Crack, layback a crack in a left-facing corner, then continue on the face, clipping two bolts plus a questionable fixed pin.
overview: A leftward-facing layback crack leads to a face holding two bolts plus a questionable fixed pin.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Duchess
beta: Work up discontinuous cracks, passing an old bolt, to reach the ledge, then continue in the chimney above.
overview: Two sections: broken cracks lead to a ledge, and a chimney completes the climb.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Dyno-soar
beta: Begin a bit beyond Gorgasaurus with bouldery moves up a seam, shift right past two bolts, then head up and right to join Negasaurus at its last crack.
overview: Begins as a boulder problem on a seam, then moves rightward past two bolts to Negasaurus's last crack.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: 10 ft right of Gorgasaurus

name: Melvin
beta: Get through the loose rock low down; the climbing turns steep and dynamic once the final headwall is reached. Pass the first bolt, then finish rightward onto the overhanging headwall.
overview: Starts past some loose rock, which is worth enduring since the upper headwall gives steep, dynamic moves. The line passes the first bolt shared with a neighbouring route, then exits up and right onto an overhanging headwall beside the crack system.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Easter Overflow
beta: Traversing in from the right at the level of bolt two turns it into a much easier outing.
overview: A four-bolt line on the face's left side. Joining it from the right at the second bolt drops the difficulty considerably.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: left portion of the face

name: Egg Shell
beta: Begin in the corner beside the pine and follow the three bolts straight to the top.
overview: A short bolted climb on a 30-foot formation, beginning in its southeast corner next to a pine.

current.area_walk_in: A path drops through the gully separating Sidehorse from Dragonfly Dome and runs straight to the rock about a hundred feet downhill.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: In the corner on the southeast side of the small rock, beside a pine

name: Egghead
beta: The upper part follows a beautiful arete; a bolt added in the gap above bolt two now removes what used to be a runout.
overview: A bolted arete and face line. Clip 7 bolts on the way up.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Gypsy Boots
beta: Follow the thin crack as it tends leftward; at the bolt atop it, step right and merge with the neighboring route's final bolt.
overview: Aid up a thin crack that leans leftward; from a bolt up top, move right to join the neighbouring line's last bolt.

current.area_walk_in: The southwest-facing wall sits over the hill from the Oz Towers; go up and left from the Poppie Field Boulders.
current.location: wall beside the preceding line, a thin leftward-trending aid crack

name: End Of The Line
beta: Share the opening thin crack with the neighboring route, then head straight up, clipping three bolts.
overview: A line that shares the thin opening crack of its neighbor Hobo Chang Ba, then continues straight up on bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Escape from Soledad
beta: Link the three bolts as they ascend the steep, sustained wall.
overview: A challenging line up a steep face, starting toward the right of the uphill face and protected by three bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: Right-hand part of the northwest-facing uphill side

name: Every Which Way but Up
beta: Follow Midnight Lumber to about mid-height, then traverse rightward along the dike with four bolts and finish up the top of The Woodshed.
overview: Shares the lower half of Midnight Lumber, then traverses rightward on a dike with four bolts and finishes via the upper section of The Woodshed.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Evolution
beta: The first pitch is short, linking a trio of solid bolts plus a couple of old ones, ending in a small cave holding the first anchors.
overview: Two-pitch sport line. A short opening pitch passes three sound bolts and a few old ones to reach a small cave holding the first anchors, then a second pitch continues above.

current.anchor: 2-bolt anchor at top; first belay in small cave

name: Exfoliation Confrontation
beta: Follow four bolts up a face covered with patina plates.
overview: Four bolts guard a face studded with numerous patina flakes.

current.area_walk_in: The way in passes through a notch in the rock before reaching the wall.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: about 40 ft right of High Noon

name: Exiled in Sweden
beta: Ascend the north face with three bolts; after the third, trend left, then angle back right to the top.
overview: The north face is protected by three bolts; above the last one you detour left before returning right to the top.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Farewell to Arms
beta: Drop-knee rests and a fist jam can help, and a dynamic lunge is the alternative; leading is avoided because protection stops when the crack does.
overview: A crack climb that peters out partway up, where the gear ends along with the crack.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Fast Track
beta: Above the bolt past the small ledge, step rightward to merge with the neighboring line.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Fear of a Black Planet
beta: Begin inside the chimney to the right, angle leftward by one bolt to reach the horizontal dike, traverse it left clipping two bolts, then finish upward with three more bolts.
overview: Begins in a chimney, heads upward and leftward clipping a bolt to reach a horizontal dike, traverses the dike, then ascends further bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: smooth wall toward the left end of the face; begins from a chimney to its right

name: Fear of Flying
beta: Begin next to the neighboring route, get by a decayed flake, then angle rightward along a dike to the face with two bolts; small TCUs are useful.
overview: Gets by a decayed flake, then angles up and right along a dike to face climbing past two bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: directly beside Ballet, on its right

name: Filet of Cole
beta: Begin five feet right of the neighboring route, follow its crack until it ends, then move up the face with two bolts.
overview: Follow the crack until it runs out, then continue on face holds clipping two bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: roughly 5 ft beyond Belfry

name: Filet of Sole
beta: Launch off the right-hand tip of Bat Ledge, surmount a bulge, then continue up the face beside Southwest Passage's upper pitch, clipping three bolts.
overview: Gets going from the terrace's far end, passes a bulge and onto the face beside Southwest Passage's second pitch.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: starts at the far-right tip of Bat Ledge

name: Finish What You Started
beta: Begin on the flake shared with the previous route, then head straight upward clipping three bolts.
overview: Climb the same flake as its neighbour, then head directly up on three bolts.

current.location: begins up the flake of the neighbouring route, then straight up
